title: Emit the results document in its three-way form: run the merged decision module beside the engine and transform the engine's output into a contract-1.3.0 document that carries, on each available answer, a value_states way-layer (settled / conditional / withheld) for every shown value; place the rear yard and the setback above the base with the permitted-envelope results and the three legal dwelling-unit limits with the floor-area results (owner row R567); reserve the apartment-estimate block for the preliminary capacity estimate so it no longer carries the legal figure (R568); withdraw from values[] every result the module withholds (coverage, rear yard, setback, the whole building option on the benchmark) so no withheld result carries a number anywhere; make the rear-yard drawing note follow the withheld result (144.60 ft from the corner, not the older 'not required'); make the floor table, the floor stack, the shortfall, the add-on gains and the best combination follow a withheld building option; regenerate the committed journey fixture and its saved DXF and kit drawings; teach the website reader the value_states layer so a withheld value shows its reason and never falls back to the first value (R556, forced because the committed fixture is shared and the web test harness renders every results fixture); update the zoning-rule review register. It does NOT mount a route, does NOT add the website results panel / client / switch / dashboard tool / browser journey, does NOT build the apartment estimator, turns on NO production switch, and changes NO rule-table value. [backlog DB-171 (F5, F6), DB-172(a), DB-175(b)(d)(e)(g), DB-185(a)(c)(d), DB-189; owner rows R567-R570, R583, R584, R588, R229, R240, R255, R257, R258, R267-R269, R543, R556]
objective: EMIT THE RESULTS DOCUMENT IN ITS THREE-WAY FORM (docs/plans/R6B_RESULTS_CONNECTION_WORK_ORDER_2026-10-06.md, Part 0; the fourth and last engine piece, after M5-T130 carried the facts, M5-T131 added the validators, and M5-T134 wired the carriers and built the adapter). THE FACTS TODAY (each with file and line at head c6f33bb73eaeff53afe96b7563ee473ef199d3b4). (1) The engine entry generate_results (services/api/app/scenario/three_answers/engine.py:210) assembles a results document that on the benchmark declares contract 1.2.0 (engine.py:256, notes slot) and SHOWS a number for every answer value, including max_lot_coverage (answers.py:297-306) and the whole building option (engine.py:274); its geometry draws the rear yard as 'not_required' (geometry.py:100-114); its unit_estimate block carries the LEGAL dwelling-unit limit under the name 'estimate' (dwelling_units.py:51-58, value 29 on the benchmark). (2) The merged decision module decide_result_ways (result_ways.py) returns a ResultWays object (result_way_inputs.py:456-481) with an AnswerWays for each of the three answers (value ways settled/conditional/withheld) plus five standalone ResultWays: rear_yard, setback_above_base, legal_unit_limit_standard, legal_unit_limit_qualifying_affordable, legal_unit_limit_qualifying_senior. (3) The adapter run_engine_and_result_ways (result_way_engine_bridge.py:60) runs the engine and gathers the ways BESIDE the document and changes nothing emitted (its docstring says NOTHING IS EMITTED). (4) Contract 1.3.0 is ALREADY in the schema (packages/contracts/schemas/v1/results.schema.json:40, value_states :352, version binding :284/:319): it is byte-identical in the runtime copy services/api/app/_contract_schemas/v1/results.schema.json and the generated web type packages/contracts/generated/results.ts already declares ValueState/ValueStates (:14-23, :104, :112) - SO NO SCHEMA, SCHEMA-COPY, OR TYPEGEN CHANGE IS NEEDED. (5) The way-layer validator app/contracts/results_way_rules.py:58 (called by both validators, contract.py:100 and study_contracts) already refuses a 1.3.0 document with a shown value that has no way entry, a key both shown and withheld, or a settled/conditional entry for no shown value, and the schema's withheld branch (results.schema.json:384-407) has no number field - SO NO NEW VALIDATOR RULE IS NEEDED; the three limits are pinned refused in services/api/tests/contracts/test_results_three_ways_slot.py (read-only confirmation). (6) On the benchmark lot the module's decision is fixed by its tests (test_result_ways_benchmark.py): with the wired overlay support (result_way_bridge_overlay.py: floor area, heights, coverage, setback and dwelling-unit supported; REAR YARD not supported) the floor-area values and the six heights are CONDITIONAL (on the recorded-area condition and the four unchecked K20 conditions), while coverage (reaches 103.93 ft from the 215 Place street line), the rear yard (144.60 ft from the corner point), the setback, the whole building option, and all three unit limits are WITHHELD. THE READINGS (the orchestrator's; marked as readings for the reviewers to confirm or correct, continuing the numbering of M5-T129/130/132/134). (O26) THE EMITTER IS THE ADAPTER PATH, NOT engine.py. engine.py must stay read-only and must never contain the text 'result_way' (the import guard, tests/scenario/three_answers/test_result_ways.py). Add ONE new focused module services/api/app/scenario/three_answers/three_way_document.py that imports the decision-module way records (result_way_inputs) and transforms an assembled results document, given a ResultWays, into the 1.3.0 three-way document; it is the SECOND new app file that names the decision module, so add it to the permitted set in the one import-guard test (exactly as M5-T134 added the adapter). (O27) THE TRANSFORM IS A PURE document -> document FUNCTION given the ways. For each of the three answers: attach a value_states map with one entry for every value key the module decided; for a settled/conditional value keep its value object in values[] and record its way (a conditional entry names each Condition's kind, the assumption in words, and what would settle it); for a withheld value REMOVE it from values[] and record a withheld entry (label, reason, gap_kind, resolved_by, and the law section where one applies, carrying no number); when EVERY value of an answer is withheld make the whole answer not_available with the additive 1.3.0 resolved_by/gap_kind fields (DB-171 F4). Place the five standalone results per owner row R567: rear_yard and setback_above_base as value_states entries of permitted_envelope; the three legal unit limits as value_states entries of floor_area_allowance; on the benchmark all five are withheld, so none appears in any values[] array. Set contract_version to 1.3.0. Reserve the apartment estimate (see O28). Make the geometry follow the withheld results (see O29). Then validate the finished document with the existing app.contracts results validator (the way-rule runs after the schema). (O28) THE APARTMENT-ESTIMATE BLOCK IS RESERVED IN THE EMITTED DOCUMENT (owner R568, R543; backlog DB-185 a). THE ORCHESTRATOR'S RULING on the draft's second question. In every document the adapter emits, the top-level unit_estimate block is the reserved block: it carries no legal figure, no formula and no factor. It is the shared not-available shape (status, reason, reason_kind): that block has NO gap_kind and NO resolved_by field in the schema, and the schema is read-only in this task. Its reason begins with the owner's words 'Not known', names the 'Preliminary capacity estimate', and says in plain words that the estimate is not built yet (owed work; never the word 'unsupported', R258). reason_kind is rule_not_implemented (THE ORCHESTRATOR'S READING of the schema's five kinds: the estimator is a calculation that does not exist yet; missing_input would say that a fact of the lot is missing, which R258 keeps apart; the reviewers confirm or correct it). THE RESERVATION IS MADE BY THE TRANSFORM, NOT IN THE ENGINE: services/api/app/scenario/three_answers/dwelling_units.py and engine.py stay READ-ONLY and byte-identical. Reasons, each checked at the claim head: (i) the decision module's way records carry no number (result_way_inputs.py, Settled / Conditional), so when the standard legal unit limit is shown, its figure, formula, factor, rounding rule and law sections must come from the rule the engine evaluates (r6b-dwelling-units), which the engine's inner unit_estimate block holds; (ii) tests/scenario/three_answers/test_three_answers_rule_access.py imports build_unit_estimate and pins its output, and the draft did not list that file; (iii) nothing but the adapter calls generate_results under services/api/app, so the engine's inner result reaches no surface: ADD A TEST that pins this (no other caller under services/api/app). (O32) THE STANDARD LEGAL UNIT LIMIT WHEN IT IS SHOWN. When the module's way for legal_unit_limit_standard is settled or conditional, the transform adds ONE value object to floor_area_allowance.values[]: key legal_unit_limit_standard, the figure of the engine's inner unit_estimate block (never recomputed in the transform), unit dwelling_units, that block's law sections, sources naming the rule table (r6b-dwelling-units at its version) and the law section, and a label that prints the formula, the factor and the rounding rule in words (the value object has no field for them; work order test H10: no value used in a calculation goes unprinted) - together with its way entry. When the way is withheld, or the engine's inner block is not available, NO value object is added and the figure appears nowhere in the document. The limits for qualifying affordable and qualifying senior housing are always withheld by the module (it works out no figure for them): they are way entries only. test_three_answers_benchmark.py is NOT edited: its lines 123 and 146 (backlog DB-185 c) keep testing the engine's INNER result, which stays at 1.2.0; the emitted document's version, law sections and estimate block are tested in the new test file. An answer has ONE measurement label (DB-185 d): say in the report what label the floor-area answer carries once a unit count sits beside square feet and ratios, and that it is still true of each value. (O29) THE DRAWINGS FOLLOW THE DOCUMENT (owner R228 in the work order; backlog DB-189). In the emitted 1.3.0 document the geometry block follows the ways: the rear yard is withheld, so geometry.yards is not_available with the independent reading's reason (the far corner is 144.60 ft from the corner point; beyond 100 ft a rear yard depends on the unrecorded lot-line types of the adjoining lots, which nobody has recorded, so it is NOT KNOWN there - from the reference reading, NEVER the older whole-lot 'not required'); the building option is withheld, so geometry.floor_plates is not_available; coverage is withheld, so the envelope tier is not_available; the lot_outline stays. The transform rewrites these layers (engine.py and geometry.py stay read-only). (O31) EVERY BLOCK WORKED OUT FROM A WITHHELD RESULT FOLLOWS IT (owner R570; work order Part 0, test H2: 'building option, floor plates, floor stack and floor table are withheld'). The draft followed the withheld results into the geometry block only. The engine's document also carries: floor_by_floor (the option's floor table), floor_stack (the floors that fit, with the allowable area of each level, which needs the coverage), shortfall (a statement about the option), addon_gains (each gain is the difference of two recomputed building options: services/api/app/scenario/addons/recalculation.py lines 146-148 and 209-212) and best_combination (chosen from those gains). On the committed benchmark document these hold numbers today (two floor rows of 10,075 sq ft; floors_fit 5 with 10,075 sq ft a level; shortfall 'none'; gains of 4,030 sq ft, 10 ft and 1 floor; a best combination). IN THE EMITTED DOCUMENT: when the building option is withheld, floor_by_floor is empty, and floor_stack, shortfall, best_combination and every add-on gain the engine shows as available are 'not available' (the shared shape) with a plain reason that names the withheld result they are worked out from; when the coverage is withheld, floor_stack and the geometry envelope are not available; the add-ons' names, groups and 'requires' lines stay. NO BLOCK OF THE EMITTED DOCUMENT CARRIES A NUMBER WORKED OUT FROM A WITHHELD RESULT. A block worked out only from shown (settled or conditional) results stays as the engine made it; that such a block has no way entries of its own is NOT repaired here (the contract has no slot for it): LIST every such block in the report, for the display piece. IF the emitted document cannot be expressed in the 1.3.0 schema as it stands, STOP and report the exact point; change no schema and drop no value silently. (O30) THE SHOWN VALUES' NUMBERS ARE NOT INVENTED HERE. The floor-area and height numbers carried as conditional are exactly the engine's existing rule-table outputs; the expected values a TEST asserts come from the reference cases (docs/reference-cases/R6B/cases/), never from the engine's saved output (rule 3; owner rule 5). STEPS. STEP 1: add three_way_document.py and its transform; add it to the import-guard permitted set. STEP 2: extend the adapter run_engine_and_result_ways (result_way_engine_bridge.py) so it gathers the ways then calls the transform and returns the 1.3.0 document beside the ways (its docstring changes from NOTHING IS EMITTED to the emitting behaviour). STEP 3: in the transform, reserve unit_estimate (O28), place the standard legal unit limit when it is shown (O32) and make every block worked out from a withheld result follow it (O31); dwelling_units.py is not edited. STEP 4: regenerate the committed journey fixture packages/contracts/fixtures/valid/results/recorded_215_16_northern_journey.json from the adapter's emitted document, and regenerate the saved DXF (tests/cad/snapshots/results_dxf/recorded_215_16_northern_journey.dxf) and kit drawings (tests/drawings/kit/snapshots/recorded_215_16_northern_journey.massing.svg and .site_plan.svg) that read it; review each regenerated file line by line against section 5 of the work order (rule 3). STEP 5: repoint the server journey test (tests/journey/test_215_16_northern_journey.py) and rewrite the wiring test (tests/scenario/three_answers/test_wiring_emits_nothing.py, whose name is now a misnomer) to the adapter path and 1.3.0. STEP 6: teach the website reader the value_states layer (apps/web/src/lib/architect/three-answers.ts answerView: a withheld value is rendered from its value_states entry as its reason and NEVER by falling back to values[0]; a conditional value shows 'If <assumption>') and AnswerCard.tsx, and update the web tests that read the fixture (the test harness apps/web/src/test-support/results-fixtures.ts globs the results fixtures directory and the panel test renders every fixture, so a withheld value in any fixture reaches the reader - R556). STEP 7: update the zoning-rule review register (authored source services/api/app/rules/review_register/register.json, re-rendered to docs/zoning-rule-review/, per docs/zoning-rule-review/GUIDE.md) for entries r6b-rear-yard-corner-waiver (now withheld on the benchmark, not 'not required'), r6b-lot-coverage (withheld on the benchmark, the reach reason) and r6b-dwelling-units (the legal limit now carried as a value-state, the estimate reserved); NO human verdict is entered (D-090-R379, ADR-007). TESTS (one per input state, each expected value from a reference case; the report holds the table 'state, outcome, test id'; a red proof on today's code; one mutation proof per pinned branch). Cover: the benchmark 1.3.0 document validates and carries the value_states; the five results placed per R567; coverage withdrawn from values[] with its reach reason; the rear yard withheld with the independent reading (not 'not required'); a document-wide scan finds NO withheld result's number anywhere; unit_estimate carries no legal figure and reads Not known; each conditional value names its assumption with no 'professional review' phrase; the user density-statement path makes the standard unit limit conditional (and a contradicting statement is refused); a made-up interior lot (step-p5, 5,355 sq ft -> 10,710) and a made-up corner lot (corner-reach C2/C3) through the emit path; a fact not given withholds only its dependents and never a zero; the regenerated fixture equals the engine output (proves nothing about correctness, rule 3); the drawings omit the withheld results and say so; the website reader renders a withheld value as its reason and never the first value. Where the law reading is 'not known' (the overlay reading owed for the rear yard; qualifying-senior 'not set by this formula'; K20 unchecked), the test asserts 'withheld' or 'conditional', never a settled value. NOT IN THIS TASK: any edit of engine.py, dwelling_units.py, geometry.py, answers.py or building_option.py; any schema, schema-copy or generated-type change; the server route that returns the document (Part A); the full website results display (a new ResultsPanel, a results-api client, a results-flag website switch, a dashboard tool, a browser journey, any page that mounts the panel) beyond the minimal reader-safety fix forced by the shared fixture; the realistic apartment estimator and any Preliminary-capacity-estimate number; turning on any production switch; any production setting or render.yaml; any rule-table value; the area tolerance of backlog DB-173 (the benchmark figures disagree and the floor-area results are conditional on the recorded area, which is correct); capturing or reading any new law text; any human verdict in the review register.
business_reason: The decision module, its validators and the carriers are built and merged, but the engine's document still shows a number for every value and the ways sit beside it, unused: the benchmark document shows coverage, a rear yard, a building option and a legal unit 'estimate' that the independent readings do not support. The owner settled on 2026-10-08 (D-090 source-060) where the five results are carried (R567), that the estimate block is reserved for the preliminary capacity estimate (R568), that legal limits and estimated counts are kept apart (R569), and that a withheld value stays withheld everywhere (R570), and released the piece to be built (R583) with every activation restriction kept (R584) and the full report and all options in scope (R588). Emitting the three-way document makes the one results document honest - unknown stays unknown (R229, R240), a user's statement is only conditional (R255), conflicting areas are conditional (R257), not-checked is never confirmed and a base height is never the property's maximum (R267-R269) - which is the foundation every later surface (the route, the website, the drawings and the PDF) reads from.
